data.narrative:
Kelluu is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised €20M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers spanning 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI, all at the same stage and sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the €20M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yields $40M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 directly comparable private companies—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—produces a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The resulting triangulated valuation range is $34M (floor) to $805M (ceiling), with a median of $370M. The wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity within the peer set: Kelluu's capital raised and inferred stage maturity position it materially below the peer median, suggesting the lower end of the range is more defensible. Key uncertainties include Kelluu's revenue run-rate relative to peers, technology differentiation within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment, and customer concentration. Additional revenue and growth-rate data would narrow this range materially.
